name: @bit-physics/web-sph-water
description: Stack-B WebGPU web build — SPH water (DFSPH). The first browser DFSPH: screen-space-rendered water over a two-tier solver whose gated core (cubic-spline kernel, density, continuity, corrector, counting-sort neighbor search) is a faithful f32 port of the verified NumPy reference, pointwise-matched against the committed 100K canonical capture; the live Bender-Koschier dual solver is labeled beyond-reference (Phase-6 verification-demo track).
